text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days into December, the gift 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, Tazuna-san. Is that cardboard 
box—
choice_data_list: Is this fan mail addressed to Tsuy...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ After all, it's Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, 
who recently delivered results in both
the 
Kyoto Daishoten and the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)♪
choice_data_list: Is that a fan letter for Tsuyoshi?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
You've completely become everyone's 
favorite horse girl, both in name and 
reality~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The favorite...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, the interview schedule for the 
contenders in the upcoming Arima Kinen is 
out, so please check it over later.
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wahya~...!
choice_data_list: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Uhyaa...! Hyaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every time she opened a fan letter, her 
cheeks flushed and her eyes softened, 
happily admiring each and every one.
choice_data_list: We have to repay all these cheers ...
We have to repay all these cheers ...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes! Of course!
choice_data_list: We've got to answer their cheers a...
We've got to answer their cheers a...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm running in that Arima Kinen, 
there are things only I can convey.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Even to those who support me―― ――...Ah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as she reached into the cardboard box 
to pull out a fan letter...
...she spotted 
something and froze.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer. When was the interview 
for the Arima Kinen scheduled for?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by her question, I reopen the 
materials Tazuna-san gave me earlier. 
According to them—
choice_data_list: In two weeks, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Two weeks later.
choice_data_list: In about two weeks, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: In that case! I have one favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! Tsuru-chan! Here's an origami 
crane from me~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You're folding a thousand paper cranes, 
aren't you? These are from the Mejiro 
family doctor and myself.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wah, thank you! Even though you're 
both so busy...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Do you mind if we give you a gift too?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, since I had a little part in this? 
...Do your best in the Arima Kinen, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ~~gh, yes! Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the paper cranes we've
gathered 
on top of the table, okay~?
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, we got something from yo...
Tsuyoshi, we also got something fr...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Really!? And we just talked about it the 
other day...!
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, we got some from your fa...
Tsuyoshi, we received some from yo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make a thousand paper cranes." 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, who had said that, 
brought over several cute containers a
few 
days later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The containers lined up there were filled 
with paper cranes. Roughly 900 of them in 
total.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she had been keeping every 
origami crane sent by her fans ever since 
her debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'll fold whatever we're short on 
myself!" She was full of enthusiasm, but 
hearing that, few friends or family 
members would leave her to do it alone.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer? Doctor? Could I do some 
needlework too...?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
No, no,
we can't let you get injured right 
before a race~. Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yes! Honestly... ow, ow, ow!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Yes! Honestly... ow ow ow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deciding it was fine, she took the needle 
again and threaded it through the paper 
cranes.
choice_data_list: By the way, are the paper cranes o...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes, and also—
choice_data_list: By the way, are the paper cranes o...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...This crane, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The origami crane she took out last... 
...was wrinkled, unlike the others.
choice_data_list: ...All right, I'll hold onto it fo...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Please.
choice_data_list: ...All right, I'll hold onto it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, day by day, time went by—

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, look,
look! The Arima Kinen interview 
is starting!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
You're right, the stream's already 
started! I'll say it again, this year's 
lineup is super stacked~.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Next up is Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!
Please give 
us your aspirations for the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Before that,
though—there's something 
I'd like to show you.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, how lovely...! Those are 
thousand-paper cranes, aren't they!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "This is my... pillar of support."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"These thousand paper cranes are a charm 
made from the cranes given to me by my 
family, my friends— and all the people 
who've always supported me!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big...
text_block_list.text:
—Wait. At the very top of those thousand 
paper cranes...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big...
text_block_list.text:
So that Tsuru-chan can run without
getting 
hurt... ...An amulet!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big...
text_block_list.text: That's my crane, right...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big...
text_block_list.text:
...You kept it all this time? All this 
time... Tsuru-chan, you held onto it...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big...
text_block_list.text: You kept it as a good luck charm...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Carrying the prayers of so many
people, I 
am able to run in the upcoming Arima 
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"So, to all of you who've gifted me so 
much love and support up until now, this 
time, I want to bring you an exciting 
dream!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Please watch me! The Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi 
you all supported is the strongest 
Umamusume there is!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
This year's Arima Kinen... I will 
definitely win it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi smiledâ as if 
exchanging precious feelings like gifts 
with those dearest to her.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Fuhyaa~...
choice_data_list: That was a great press conference,...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It's all thanks to Trainer-san 
and everyone supporting me.
choice_data_list: That was a great press conference,...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even though I suddenly asked to make a 
thousand paper cranes, you helped me all 
the way to the end again...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Not at all. Besides... 
Tsurumaru-san.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Santa's work isn't finished yet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: Santa's job?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall take my leave here. Ho ho ho 
ho...♪
choice_data_list: Santa duties?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with the personal physician quickly 
taking his leave,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi and I 
ended up having our own little 
celebration.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wah... So pretty...
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, is there anything you wa...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh? What I want to eat? Hmmm...
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, is there anything you wa...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather have whatever you want to eat, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
did you realize? This is also 
a 'Thank You for Helping Out' party."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: So... please, go ahead first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi thrust something 
forward vigorously. It was—
choice_data_list: ...Gloves?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! Here's a present from Santa Tsuyoshi!
choice_data_list: ...Gloves?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Dedicated to you, who cheered me on from 
the closest spot today too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
By the way, those gloves... take a close 
look. There's a tiny crane on the back of 
the left hand.
choice_data_list: Ah, you're right. It's cute.
Ah, you're right. How cute.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! I thought store-bought was 
too plain, so I added some appliqué!
choice_data_list: Oh, you're right. That's cute.
Oh, you're right. It is cute.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I borrowed an iron from the dorm head! 
Under the teacher's guidance so I
wouldn't 
burn myself, I was super, suuuper careful!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You already have so many things, Trainer, 
so I wanted to give you something special 
that only I could offer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Um... do you like those gloves?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Would it be weird... for that crane to 
stay by your side, Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Ahaha, yeah. Maybe we should be to...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ――! Yes!
choice_data_list: Ahaha, yeah. Maybe we should hang ...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Please stay healthy every year, so that 
crane doesn't get lonely.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you don't catch a cold either. 
Dress warmly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll help with anything if it's for that 
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Please live a long, long life.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Please stay with me forever and ever.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Cranes live for a thousand years.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slipping on the gifted gloves,
I hold them 
up against my chest.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
I'm gonna order 10 mega-sized bowls 
of ramen!
choice_data_list: Then let's go grab some ramen to w...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Piece of cake! With how I am now, it's 
totally a breeze!
choice_data_list: Whoa, think you can finish all that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bouncing along with lively hops,
Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi leads the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
May that crane, too—live for thousands of 
years.
